end.line: Quillon for Fenwick Lowe’s disputes group

vo: Fenwick Lowe’s disputes group runs around sixty live arbitrations, each built from productions of fifty thousand documents.
Quillon builds the chronology from the exhibits: eighty-six events from twelve hundred and forty exhibits, each linked to its source.
Ask about the record, and the answer comes back with every statement cited to the exact page.
Review a whole production at once, with each issue pulled into its own column across every document.
Hannah will walk your team through it on Tuesday the tenth.
